# Execution quality: exchange fills and OTC/broker trades

**Day shown:** notebook variable `@day` (default `'$yesterday'`, a UTC day). Tomorrow it shows today's session by itself. To pin a date, set it to e.g. `'2026-11-11'`.

**How to read it.** Markout = signed mid move after our trade, in bps of fill price, **positive = good for us**. Mid comes from the venue we traded on (`energy_quotes.source = venue`). A passive fill should start near **+half-spread** and keep it. If it slides negative over seconds or minutes, we are being picked off. An aggressive fill starts near **-half-spread**, and it is fine if it recovers. Treat |t| < 2 as noise; with ~40 traders or counterparties, one or two will show |t| ≈ 2 by chance. USD figures use current FX (`energy_usd_factor_asof`), which is close enough for ranking.

**11 Nov 2026 summary**
1. **No systematic pick-off on exchange.** Across all fills, passive trades earn +1.23 bps at the fill (half-spread 1.27) and +2.1 bps after 5 min. Aggressive trades pay -1.24 bps and recover to +0.76 bps by 30 min. Markouts are flat from -10 s to +5 s, so there is no last-look or latency signature.
2. **The NBP "pick-off" is one market move.** Passive NBP fills show -26 bps / about -$180k to -$240k at 30 min. All of it comes from 12 fills between 09:00 and 10:00, when NBP and TTF both rallied about 7% (09:30-09:50) while the desk was net short (about 4.9 M therms sold 09:00-09:45). Excluding that hour, passive NBP is +3.9 bps at 30 min. It is a positioning loss, not adverse selection: the 5 s markouts on those fills are only -1 to -2 bps.
3. **OTC/broker: industrial and utility counterparties look informed (over 3 days).** INDUSTRIAL group: n=114, -1.1 bps at the trade, -3.1 bps at 5 min (t -3.7), -9.5 bps at 30 min (t -3.8). On 11 Nov alone the effect is small, so treat it as something to watch: INDUSTRIAL_08, UTILITY_10, PRODUCER_03 and UTILITY_02 are the worst names.
4. **Not execution problems:** OTC trades are booked on average 5.4 h late (86 of 101 more than 1 h late, max 24 h). There are 5 exchange fills whose booked qty or price differs from the venue fill. The EEX quote feed went dark 08:45-08:48 UTC; no EEX fills were affected.

WITH x AS (
  SELECT f.symbol, f.curve, f.passive, h.offset / 1000000000 AS horizon_s, count() AS n,
         sum(abs(f.qty) * f.px) AS notional,
         sum(CASE WHEN f.qty > 0 THEN (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - f.px ELSE f.px - (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 END * abs(f.qty)) AS pnl
  FROM energy_fills f
  HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (f.symbol = q.symbol AND f.venue = q.source)
  LIST (0, 60s, 300s, 1800s) AS h
  WHERE f.ts IN @day
), usd AS (
  SELECT x.curve, x.passive, x.horizon_s, sum(x.n) AS n, sum(x.notional * fx.factor) AS notional_usd, sum(x.pnl * fx.factor) AS pnl_usd
  FROM x JOIN energy_usd_factor_asof fx ON x.symbol = fx.symbol
  GROUP BY x.curve, x.passive, x.horizon_s
)
SELECT curve, CASE WHEN passive THEN 'passive' ELSE 'aggressive' END AS flow,
       max(n) AS fills, round(max(notional_usd) / 1e6, 1) AS notional_musd,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_s = 0 THEN pnl_usd END) / max(notional_usd) * 10000, 2) AS bps_at_fill,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_s = 60 THEN pnl_usd END) / max(notional_usd) * 10000, 2) AS bps_1m,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_s = 300 THEN pnl_usd END) / max(notional_usd) * 10000, 2) AS bps_5m,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_s = 1800 THEN pnl_usd END) / max(notional_usd) * 10000, 2) AS bps_30m,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_s = 300 THEN pnl_usd END)) AS pnl_usd_5m,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_s = 1800 THEN pnl_usd END)) AS pnl_usd_30m
FROM usd
GROUP BY curve, passive
ORDER BY pnl_usd_30m
cells.name: Scorecard by curve and flow (USD, markout at fill / 1m / 5m / 30m)

SELECT h.offset / 1000000000.0 AS horizon_s,
       avg(CASE WHEN f.passive THEN (CASE WHEN f.qty > 0 THEN (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - f.px ELSE f.px - (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 END) / f.px * 10000 END) AS passive_bps,
       avg(CASE WHEN NOT f.passive THEN (CASE WHEN f.qty > 0 THEN (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - f.px ELSE f.px - (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 END) / f.px * 10000 END) AS aggressive_bps,
       avg((q.ask - q.bid) / ((q.ask + q.bid) / 2) * 10000) / 2 AS half_spread_bps
FROM energy_fills f
HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (f.symbol = q.symbol AND f.venue = q.source)
LIST (-300s, -60s, -10s, 0, 1s, 5s, 30s, 60s, 120s, 300s, 600s, 1800s) AS h
WHERE f.ts IN @day
ORDER BY horizon_s
cells.name: Markout curve, all exchange fills (bps vs seconds from fill)

SELECT f.curve, h.offset / 1000000000.0 AS horizon_s,
       avg((CASE WHEN f.qty > 0 THEN (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - f.px ELSE f.px - (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 END) / f.px * 10000) AS passive_markout_bps
FROM energy_fills f
HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (f.symbol = q.symbol AND f.venue = q.source)
LIST (-60s, 0, 5s, 30s, 60s, 300s, 600s, 1800s) AS h
WHERE f.ts IN @day AND f.passive AND f.curve IN ('NBP', 'TTF', 'UKPWR', 'BRENT', 'WTI')
ORDER BY horizon_s, f.curve
cells.name: Passive markout by curve (bps vs seconds from fill)

SELECT ts AS bucket, last(close) AS nbp_dec26_mid FROM energy_quotes_1m WHERE symbol = 'NBP_Dec-26' AND ts IN @day SAMPLE BY 15m;
WITH x AS (
  SELECT f.symbol, timestamp_floor('15m', f.ts) AS bucket, f.passive,
         sum(CASE WHEN f.qty > 0 THEN (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - f.px ELSE f.px - (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 END * abs(f.qty)) AS pnl
  FROM energy_fills f
  HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (f.symbol = q.symbol AND f.venue = q.source)
  LIST (1800s) AS h
  WHERE f.ts IN @day AND f.curve = 'NBP'
)
SELECT x.bucket, round(sum(CASE WHEN x.passive THEN x.pnl * fx.factor ELSE 0 END)) AS passive_pnl_usd_30m,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN NOT x.passive THEN x.pnl * fx.factor ELSE 0 END)) AS aggressive_pnl_usd_30m
FROM x JOIN energy_usd_factor_asof fx ON x.symbol = fx.symbol
GROUP BY x.bucket ORDER BY x.bucket
cells.name: NBP: 30-min markout P&L per 15-min bucket (USD, bars) vs NBP Dec-26 mid

WITH x AS (
  SELECT f.trader, f.book, f.passive, h.offset / 1000000000 AS horizon_s, count() AS n,
         avg((CASE WHEN f.qty > 0 THEN (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - f.px ELSE f.px - (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 END) / f.px * 10000) AS mk,
         stddev_samp((CASE WHEN f.qty > 0 THEN (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - f.px ELSE f.px - (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 END) / f.px * 10000) AS sd
  FROM energy_fills f
  HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (f.symbol = q.symbol AND f.venue = q.source)
  LIST (0, 300s, 1800s) AS h
  WHERE f.ts IN @day
)
SELECT trader, book, CASE WHEN passive THEN 'passive' ELSE 'aggressive' END AS flow, max(n) AS fills,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_s = 0 THEN mk END), 2) AS bps_at_fill,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_s = 300 THEN mk END), 2) AS bps_5m,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_s = 300 THEN mk / (sd / sqrt(n)) END), 1) AS t_5m,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_s = 1800 THEN mk END), 2) AS bps_30m,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_s = 1800 THEN mk / (sd / sqrt(n)) END), 1) AS t_30m
FROM x
GROUP BY trader, book, passive
ORDER BY t_5m
cells.name: Trader scorecard: exchange fills (t = markout / std err)

WITH x AS (
  SELECT t.counterparty, t.symbol, h.offset / 1000000 AS horizon_s, count() AS n,
         sum((CASE WHEN t.qty > 0 THEN (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - t.px ELSE t.px - (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 END) / t.px * 10000) AS s_bps,
         sum(power((CASE WHEN t.qty > 0 THEN (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - t.px ELSE t.px - (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 END) / t.px * 10000, 2)) AS s2_bps,
         sum(CASE WHEN t.qty > 0 THEN (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - t.px ELSE t.px - (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 END * abs(t.qty)) AS pnl
  FROM ((SELECT * FROM energy_trade_events WHERE trade_ts IN @day AND version = 1 AND channel != 'EXCH' ORDER BY trade_ts) timestamp(trade_ts)) t
  HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (t.symbol = q.symbol AND q.source IN ('ICE', 'ICE_ENDEX', 'CME'))
  LIST (0, 300s, 1800s) AS h
), g AS (
  SELECT x.counterparty, x.horizon_s, sum(x.n) AS n, sum(x.s_bps) / sum(x.n) AS mk,
         sqrt((sum(x.s2_bps) - sum(x.s_bps) * sum(x.s_bps) / sum(x.n)) / (sum(x.n) - 1)) AS sd,
         sum(x.pnl * fx.factor) AS pnl_usd
  FROM x JOIN energy_usd_factor_asof fx ON x.symbol = fx.symbol
  GROUP BY x.counterparty, x.horizon_s
)
SELECT counterparty, max(n) AS trades,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_s = 0 THEN mk END), 2) AS bps_at_trade,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_s = 300 THEN mk END), 2) AS bps_5m,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_s = 300 THEN mk / (sd / sqrt(n)) END), 1) AS t_5m,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_s = 1800 THEN mk END), 2) AS bps_30m,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_s = 1800 THEN mk / (sd / sqrt(n)) END), 1) AS t_30m,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_s = 300 THEN pnl_usd END)) AS pnl_usd_5m,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_s = 1800 THEN pnl_usd END)) AS pnl_usd_30m
FROM g GROUP BY counterparty ORDER BY pnl_usd_5m
cells.name: OTC / broker counterparty scorecard (day)

WITH x AS (
  SELECT t.counterparty, h.offset / 1000000 AS horizon_s, count() AS n,
         sum((CASE WHEN t.qty > 0 THEN (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - t.px ELSE t.px - (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 END) / t.px * 10000) AS s_bps,
         sum(power((CASE WHEN t.qty > 0 THEN (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 - t.px ELSE t.px - (q.bid + q.ask) / 2 END) / t.px * 10000, 2)) AS s2_bps
  FROM ((SELECT * FROM energy_trade_events WHERE version = 1 AND channel != 'EXCH' ORDER BY trade_ts) timestamp(trade_ts)) t
  HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (t.symbol = q.symbol AND q.source IN ('ICE', 'ICE_ENDEX', 'CME'))
  LIST (0, 300s, 1800s) AS h
), g AS (
  SELECT left(counterparty::varchar, strpos(counterparty::varchar, '_') - 1) AS cpty_type, horizon_s,
         sum(n) AS n, sum(s_bps) / sum(n) AS mk,
         sqrt((sum(s2_bps) - sum(s_bps) * sum(s_bps) / sum(n)) / (sum(n) - 1)) AS sd
  FROM x GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT cpty_type, max(n) AS trades,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_s = 0 THEN mk END), 2) AS bps_at_trade,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_s = 300 THEN mk END), 2) AS bps_5m,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_s = 300 THEN mk / (sd / sqrt(n)) END), 1) AS t_5m,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_s = 1800 THEN mk END), 2) AS bps_30m,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_s = 1800 THEN mk / (sd / sqrt(n)) END), 1) AS t_30m
FROM g GROUP BY cpty_type ORDER BY t_5m
cells.name: OTC / broker by counterparty type, all history in the DB

cells.value:
SELECT channel, count_distinct(trade_id::varchar) AS trades,
       sum(CASE WHEN version > 1 AND status = 'AMENDED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS amendments,
       sum(CASE WHEN status = 'CANCELLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancels,
       round(avg(CASE WHEN version = 1 THEN datediff('s', trade_ts, booked_ts) END) / 3600.0, 2) AS avg_booking_lag_h,
       round(max(CASE WHEN version = 1 THEN datediff('s', trade_ts, booked_ts) END) / 3600.0, 2) AS max_booking_lag_h,
       sum(CASE WHEN version = 1 AND datediff('s', trade_ts, booked_ts) > 3600 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS booked_over_1h_late
FROM energy_trade_events WHERE trade_ts IN @day GROUP BY channel ORDER BY channel
cells.name: Not execution: booking lag and amendments by channel

cells.value:
WITH e AS (SELECT * FROM energy_trade_events WHERE booked_ts >= dateadd('d', -7, now()) AND channel = 'EXCH' LATEST ON booked_ts PARTITION BY trade_id)
SELECT f.ts, f.trader, f.symbol, f.venue, f.qty AS fill_qty, e.qty AS booked_qty, f.px AS fill_px, e.px AS booked_px, e.status, e.reason, e.booked_ts
FROM energy_fills f JOIN e ON f.trade_id = e.trade_id
WHERE f.ts IN @day AND (f.qty != e.qty OR f.px != e.px OR e.status != 'NEW')
ORDER BY f.ts
cells.name: Not execution: exchange fills whose booking differs from the venue fill

WITH s AS (SELECT ts, source, count() AS quotes FROM energy_quotes WHERE ts IN @day AND source IN ('ICE', 'ICE_ENDEX', 'EEX', 'CME', 'FX_FEED') SAMPLE BY 1m FILL(0))
SELECT ts AS minute, source, quotes FROM s WHERE quotes = 0 ORDER BY ts, source
